name: pet loss grief
description: Someone grieving a dead dog, then an empty house after losing a cat, then being told it was just a pet. Verifies all three stay on the pet_loss/grief threads with real acknowledgment instead of a dismissive or generic reply.

turns.text: My dog died and I cannot stop crying
I lost my cat last week and the house feels empty
People say it was just a pet but I am grieving hard

expected.finalTurn: Turn 1 opens the pet_loss thread for a dog's death. Turn 2 stays on pet_loss for the empty house. Turn 3 keeps the dismissal-fighting grief on pet_loss.
expected.behavior: Losing a pet is treated as real grief: the engine never dismisses it as 'just a pet' and never falls to a generic fallback.
